title: BLANK = DATE ( 1899, 12, 30 ) is TRUE: the zero date equals BLANK

source.quote: All comparison operators except == treat BLANK as equal to number 0, empty string "", DATE(1899, 12, 30), or FALSE
source.supports: = treats BLANK as equal to DATE ( 1899, 12, 30 )

notes: The expression is the one the operator reference names. The Microsoft DATE page says dates from March 1, 1900 are supported, and DAX Guide says a year from 100 to 9999 is used as it is; if DATE fails for 1899 on a server, the literal dt"1899-12-30" states the same value.
